systems.system: Phillips aluminium sample as an equal-volume sphere, normal-state electrons, 1 K

surface_site_density_relative_to_1_over_.note: real crystal faces change the prefactor of sigma_crit by these factors; both lie inside the f = 0.25-4 sensitivity band

assumptions.geometry: sample treated as a sphere of equal volume
assumptions.entropy: normal-state electronic entropy gamma*T only; lattice entropy neglected (Debye 427.7 K)

aluminium_superconducting_lattice_crossi.model: zero-field weak-coupling BCS electronic entropy + Debye phonon entropy; nuclear spins excluded
aluminium_superconducting_lattice_crossi.factor_meaning: f multiplies the threshold: sigma prefactor (k_B/a^2 -> f k_B/a^2) times the sample's A/V relative to a sphere; for a geometrically similar sample, f = R_sphere/R_sample (size dependence)
aluminium_superconducting_lattice_crossi.phillips_reported_anomaly: measured C_s near 0.17 K about 4x the exponential extrapolation (ALUMINUM_CROSSOVER.md)
aluminium_superconducting_lattice_crossi.status: post hoc: found after the anomaly was known; not evidence

combined_a_d_ratios.system: Sun (assumed nominal radius and effective temperature)
